name: coplan
description: Open-source visual planning workspace for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: shape the agent's plan as architecture diagrams and a task list, hand it to your build harness, and follow progress on a board.

interface.shortDescription: Plan on a canvas, hand it off, follow progress
interface.longDescription: Codex publishes its plan to a local browser workspace: the architecture as diagrams you can rewire and annotate, and a task tree you can reorganize. Review the exact handoff, submit it to your build harness, and follow each task across the board as it reports.
defaultPrompt: Plan this in Coplan before we build it
